warning: WorldCover classes do not directly equal Rational Method land-use categories. These ranges are proxy assumptions informed by FHWA HEC-22 and must be calibrated/validated before operational use.

50.name: Built-up
50.proxy: Urban land; actual value depends strongly on impervious surface/use

80.name: Permanent water
80.proxy: Water surface; not treated as contributing land area in Rational Method

90.name: Herbaceous wetland
90.proxy: Wet/open vegetated area; requires local calibration

95.name: Mangroves
95.proxy: Wet vegetated area; requires local calibration
